physical_vector.definition: self/friend/evader/obstacle continuous features plus token masks; role columns removed; friend tokens physical-lexicographically sorted

counterfactual_role_sensitivity.note: counterfactual teacher sensitivity; no role bit is restored to the student

interpretation.policy_shortcut: own self role, friend role values, and role-dependent friend ordering are absent from the student view
interpretation.hidden_state_test: close cross-role physical pairs with different teacher actions indicate information not represented by instantaneous role-free local geometry
interpretation.classification_rule: direct target mask difference suggests local target evidence/history; neighbor mask difference suggests neighbor target evidence; otherwise role history/release timer is the leading proxy
